newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Crepe prices hold firm at Colombo auction.
newsitem.headline: Crepe prices hold firm at Colombo auction.

text.p: Crepe prices held firm at Colombo's auction despite increased quantities because of better weather in tapping areas, brokers said on Thursday.
"The market is holding despite a slight increase in quantities," said a broker at Forbes and Walker.
Exporters said Colombo RSS prices were above other markets.
"Manufacturers can buy cheaper from other sources," one said.

Best latex one-x, the purest grade, fetched 88 rupees ($1.51) per kg the same as on Tuesday when the auction was last held. Number one fell to 86.50 rupees from 87 on Tuesday while RSS1 rose to 63.75 from 63.40.
On offer were 176 tonnes of crepe, 37 tonnes of scrap crepe and 13 tonnes of sheet rubber. ($1=58.41)
Sri Lanka is the world's biggest manufacturer of sole crepe.
